title: Like one mold/ the other, not so much!
text: Like one mold/ the other, not so much!. The mold that supplies nice, big square ice cubes is great.  One of the ice cubes is so big that you only need one for "on the rocks"!  The "egg" mold is a mystery we haven't solved -  we get lots of half eggs, but how do you get whole eggs?  The instructions aren't all that easy to follow, so we've put that mold aside.  The square mold is in constant use and it will be very popular this summer!  Fun!

product_metadata.title: Doubleggs Ice Cube Tray - Set of 2, Large Silicone Combo Mold Sphere with Lid & Square Flexible Ice Cube Molds for Whiskey, Cocktails, Juice and Any Drinks- Reusable & BPA Free (Blue)
features: 【Superior Quality】Our ice sphere maker is made with top-quality silicone, which is food-grade and safe to use. Our silicone ice molds are BPA free, guaranteed to withstand any resistance test.Better yet, each tray is easy to clean off quickly and they’re dishwasher safe.

【Square Ice Cubes】 – Our jumbo square molds creates 6 giant cubes at 2 inches each. More than a novelty, big ice slowly melting, making them ideal for your Old Fashioned, Scotch Whisky, Bourbon or Blended Whiskey. Perfect for chilling your cocktail glass!

【Spherical Ice Ball Mold】 – Better than other round ice makers with 4 slots, our ice molds create 6 ice 2 inches balls or spheres. Use them to cool your craft cocktails, iced cold brew coffee, popsicles, infused mint for Mojitos, or frozen lemonade.

【Simple NON-STICK Design】 – Unlike stiff plastic ice cube trays, our flexible ice trays are made of durable silicone. These flexible ice molds can be easily twisted or pushed from the bottom to remove ice cubes for an easy release.
